implementation_notes: No test framework in the standard library: use a small harness of `assert`-based macros plus a memory checker. Unit-test pure functions exhaustively; run integration tests under ASan/UBSan because C's failure modes are memory errors, not exceptions.
idiom_name: assert-based unit harness + sanitizers for integration
pitfalls: Tests that leak, so the suite fails only under sanitizers
Only testing the happy path because error paths dereference NULL in tests
